description: Canonical command registry for noetic-dev governance. Only commands registered here can satisfy validation, test, or gate requirements.

repo.validate.description: Validate repository invariants (required files, whitespace, links, anchors). This is a validation/check, not a test.

tests.all.description: Run all genuine tests under tests/ using Python stdlib unittest. Validate_repo.py is never counted as a test.

governance.manifest.description: Validate an evidence manifest against its schema and invariant rules.

governance.delivery_gate.description: Run delivery gate checks against an evidence manifest. Fail-closed on missing provenance.

workflow.pinning.description: Check that all GitHub Actions workflow files use pinned full-SHA action refs.

rules.model_prose_not_evidence: Model output stating 'tests passed' without captured command exit codes and output hashes is ignored.
